parameters.name: AppIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the applications to query. This parameter is a formatted JSON array that supports up to 100 AppId values separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: AppNames
parameters.description: The list of applications to query. If this parameter is empty, all application information is queried.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A string generated by the server that serves as an identifier for the client request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) to query the list of regions supported by EBS Lens.
